assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Turn the supplied two visitor portrait atlases into one NEW exact 3-column by 2-row atlas of six compact classroom scenes, separate cells, even cream gutters at the exact thirds and half, landscape orientation. First reference is for original first-row character identities only. Second reference is for second-row character identities only. Keep hair, outfits, age and face distinct. Clean quiet paper-grain matte gouache, warm cream, pine and apricot, readable silhouettes, no text, letters, numbers, balloons, logos or other visitors. Crop each scene with both people fully visible and room around them. TOP LEFT: wide welcome scene at an original community shadow-puppet exhibition, two paper lanterns and a quiet arched doorway, the first-reference teal-glasses girl and coral-sweater child stand together at a small low welcome stand at left and smile as the rust-sweater father comes in from the right. TOP MIDDLE: same teal-glasses girl and same rust-sweater father close to one another at the welcome stand, she clearly turns her face and gives him an open-hand wave; the father looks back. TOP RIGHT: same teal-glasses girl at the left, talking TO the coral-sweater child next to her while extending her hand toward the rust-sweater father across an open gap in the same room; the distant father stays on the right near the doorway. BOTTOM LEFT: different story and characters from second reference, yellow-hair-clip girl in mint clearly waves with open hand directly at the new friend wearing white cap and orange overalls, who looks back, a red-sweater child stands silently to the side. BOTTOM MIDDLE: same three second-reference children and same spacing, yellow-hair-clip girl turns and waves directly to the red-sweater child on her LEFT while the friend in white cap waits unnoticed on her RIGHT, looking toward her. BOTTOM RIGHT: same three second-reference children and same spacing, yellow-hair-clip girl is occupied looking down at a blank plain cream paper on the welcome table, hands down, friend in white cap waits without being greeted. Do not add extra figures.
